title: WeatherCore: Core Loop
summary: Check the forecast, plan exposure, travel in windows, and shelter early.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Check forecast, choose equipment, time the route, react to warnings, and update base layouts if weather repeatedly punishes the same area.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each weather window, note which gear, route, shelter, or timing choice mattered. Bring that lesson into the next forecast.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Stop before the sky closes your route. Good weather planning feels boring because the dangerous part never gets a vote.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
